ImageDescription.value: Kőris Community Garden on a Józsefváros Municipality owned corner plot. Est. 2024 (2021?). There are 40 individual/family and 4 teaching plots. In the Garden, educational activities that shape perspectives, mulching, and water-saving cultivation methods are particularly important. They also operate a community composting system. With the participation of the community, several insect hotels have been established, and many bird feeders and water stations have been installed. - Photo taken on Budapest100 2025 event.
